expected_structure: final-question payoff -> changed inner state -> ordinary activity -> one pair thread develops -> unresolved exit
primary_interaction_hypothesis: The latest tutoring conversation gets a short payoff before a new domestic or tuition setting
alternative_opening: A next-day or later present-time cold open may precede retrospective resolution, as in E04

scenes.title: Unanswered request at the end of tuition
scenes.time: Immediately following E04 closing or presented briefly as a retrospective
scenes.objective: Pay off the final personal question/comment without silently pretending it was already resolved
directions: Begin with the just-finished conversation so the reader can identify which question needs a reply
Dhika responds in her recognizable expressive, slightly embarrassed teacher voice; she may correct tone or deflect
Keep Bantu eager to continue conversation; Bobby's reaction is quieter and distinct
Allow Dhika to close the tutoring session deliberately
scenes.inner_tension: Does Dhika see this as harmless banter or an increasingly uncomfortable distraction?
scenes.exit: Twins leave or a clear time transition is signalled

scenes.title: Short private decompression
scenes.objective: Make Dhika compare changed confidence at home tuition with her earlier embarrassment
directions: Return her to an ordinary domestic task
Have a short internal comparison between how Bantu and Bobby each spoke, without treating their intentions as identical
Leave room for both fondness and concern; do not resolve contradictory feelings with a flat summary
scenes.inner_tension: Familiarity has changed but her self-image and role as teacher remain relevant
scenes.exit: Routine event or family context interrupts

scenes.title: Bantu and Bobby debrief
scenes.time: After leaving class or at next opportunity
scenes.setting: A familiar walk home or private meeting (setting speculative)
scenes.objective: Contrast Bantu's planning with Bobby's quieter confidence and show what each actually understands
directions: Allow Bantu to analyze the tutoring exchange openly
Bobby reacts with a few specific lines rather than a long monologue
End with a difference in their expectations for the next visit
scenes.inner_tension: Bantu's strategic enthusiasm versus Bobby's uncertainty and empathy
scenes.exit: Separate paths or a future tutoring commitment

scenes.title: Ordinary family baseline
scenes.objective: Preserve family life and the everyday circumstances framing encounters
directions: Establish family routine in a few grounded exchanges
Use a practical issue such as household plans without manufacturing a new revelation
Keep Dhika's private information distinct from what John knows
scenes.exit: Next planned practical task or tutoring obligation

scenes.title: Reintroduce painting continuity
scenes.time: Another suitable visit or phone request—not assumed the immediate next day
scenes.objective: Carry forward the unfinished painting project and remembered awkward conversation
directions: Give a mundane reason for contact before discussing emotional residue
Show Chotu returning to his helpful practical role rather than jumping to a new physical milestone
Show whether Dhika and Chotu avoid or acknowledge the prior awkward exchange; mark any new boundary change as a fresh event
scenes.exit: Task continues; next interruption or conversation opportunity

scenes.title: Return to a teaching scene
scenes.objective: Test Bobby's expressed intention to be more outspoken against Bantu's lead
directions: Start from a real lesson rather than personal discussion
Bobby opens with a clearer line than usual; Dhika acknowledges the change
Bantu attempts a joke or follow-up; teacher may explicitly redirect toward studies
Use pauses and short speaker turns to show different personalities
scenes.inner_tension: Bobby growing more vocal while Dhika balances warmth and classroom role
scenes.exit: A novel ordinary problem or an unanswered interpersonal question

scenes.title: Episode's emotional comparison
scenes.objective: Consolidate one character-change checkpoint through a remembered contrast, not a label
directions: Use a character-specific internal question with distinct earlier and present behavior
Keep what she knows separate from what the boys privately think
Do not manufacture conclusions about the future
scenes.inner_tension: Changing behavior and a continuing self-image
scenes.exit: Interrupt with an ordinary task or cliffhanger

scenes.title: Unresolved ending
scenes.setting: One of the established encounter settings
scenes.objective: End at a consequential question or newly noticed detail, leaving the next speaker's response unwritten
directions: Introduce one unanswered question rather than an unmotivated shock
Stop before the character's reply
Record exactly who must respond and when it can be answered in E06
scenes.inner_tension: Reader expects a meaningful response next

style_instructions.narration: Casual close-third narrator, everyday task anchor, visible reactions and each character's distinct private knowledge
style_instructions.rhythm: Short dialogue exchanges and timely interjections; a humorous deflection followed by an ordinary-task reset
analysis_invariants: Do not call this E05 canon before reading E05
Do not count predicted action as accomplished
Do not backfill source lines that are unknown
Keep Bobby and Bantu perspectives separate
Remember the Chotu painting project may resume but is not certain to be the immediate next encounter
Carry forward the actual E04 final unanswered question

review_rubric.comparison_method: mark hit/partial/miss with actual E05 line citations; never alter frozen prediction; save a new comparison file

explicitness: Non-graphic, character-driven direction; no invented erotic anatomical choreography
